subject: Stakeholder mapping & champion enablement — next steps (Finovate)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Gomez <elena@finovate.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder mapping & champion enablement — next steps (Finovate)

Thanks for taking the time today, Elena — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our end:

Call recap (30 min)
- Primary use case: reduce customer support response time with retrieval-augmented generation and templated outputs
- Decision criteria called out by your team: latency targets, SOC2/compliance, TCO vs current vendor, and ease of integration with existing message queues
- Timeline you shared: procurement window in mid-April, pilot goal in May

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Can you confirm the stakeholder list and who owns procurement/legal/security? (we heard Carlos Ruiz as economic buyer)
2) Any specific procurement pack or security questionnaire we should prep for (e.g., your vendor security form)?
3) Champion enablement: would a 30–45 min internal enablement session (talk tracks + ROI calculator) next week help the internal selling motion? We can include a short role-play for Carlos and the security folks.

Attachments: Redwood_Roleplay_TalkTracks.pdf (talk tracks + ROI examples)

If that looks right, I’ll schedule a slot and loop in Dev + Vivek for technical Q&A.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Elena Gomez <elena@finovate.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@finovate.com>, Procurement <procurement@finovate.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping & champion enablement — next steps (Finovate)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the summary, this is super helpful. Confirming stakeholders below:

Stakeholder mapping
- Economic buyer: Carlos Ruiz (SVP Finance) — final sign-off on spend
- Technical sponsor: Laura Chen, Head of Data Platforms (we’ll loop her in for the pilot scoping)
- Security: Priya Malhotra (security lead) — will own SOC/compliance checklist
- Procurement: procurement@finovate.com (template-based PO; 2–3 week review)
- Champion: Elena Gomez (operational owner) — will drive adoption if pilot delivers on SLA

Procurement / security asks
- We will need a SOC 2 summary and a quick note on data residency. Can you share SOC2_Audit_Summary.pdf and a short doc on data handling for the pilot?
- Procurement team prefers to see a mutual action plan and a simple SOW for the pilot (1 month).

Champion enablement
- Yes — a 30 min session next Tue/Wed afternoon (ET) would be ideal. Can you include a short ROI slide and example talk tracks for Carlos and Priya? That will help me prep the internal invites.

Attaching: Finovate-MAP.xlsx (internal stakeholder map)

Thanks,
Elena Gomez
Head of Customer Operations | Finovate
elena@finovate.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping & champion enablement — next steps (Finovate)

Perfect — thanks for the clarity, Elena. Attaching the SOC2 summary and our enablement materials. Proposed plan:

1) Enablement (30–45m) — talk tracks + ROI walkthrough + 10m role-play for economic buyer/security (we’ll provide call script): propose Tue 31 Mar 2026 11:00 AM ET or Wed 1 Apr 2026 2:00 PM ET
2) Technical Q&A with Laura (30m) — include Dev + Vivek to cover integration and pilot scope
3) Mutual action plan / SOW — I’ll draft a 1-month pilot SOW and send it to procurement for an initial review (will include success criteria and rollback terms)

Attachments included:
- Redwood_Roleplay_TalkTracks.pdf (enablement deck + talk tracks)
- SOC2_Audit_Summary.pdf (redacted summary)
- Pilot_SOW_Template.docx (stub; we’ll fill with pilot details)

Thanks,
Marissa
